Results.ReviewText: Just bought my first Weber and so far I'm very happy with it.
Results.Title: First Timer is Happy

Results.ReviewText: Love the new grill. This replaced a 4 burner Kenmore gas grill that lasted 15 years. Although the Weber has only 2 burners it is perfect for us. Easy to light and keep clean also. We especially like the fact that the side shelves fold down when not in use and takes up a smaller footprint on our deck..
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: Cooked great from the very first time I lit it up. Heats up fast, grates clean up easy and cooks beautifully. Love it!
Results.Title: My Weber E-210

Results.ReviewText: easy to assemble . heats up fast and cooks fantastic. builtin weight scale for propane tank also a plus . great construction and quality of finish
Results.Title: Should have went with Weber a long time ago

Results.ReviewText: I am very pleased with the overall performance of the grill. It is just the right size for our balcony. It heats up very quickly and stays at temperature very well. The rotisserie we bought with it is great. My one knock is even at the lowest setting of the two burners the grill gets hotter than needed. Turning one side off sets the unit to indirect heat which is not what I want when food is on both sides. I emailed Weber last week but no response. There should be a low flame adjustment somewhere.
Results.Title: Very good grill for the size.

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill! I thought it was going to be too small, but it is absolutely not. Great quality, great purchase!
Results.Title: Best grill I've ever had

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill at Lowe’s and put it together myself. The directions were crystal clear and I ended up with the extra parts supplied. Love cooking on it and cleanup is so easy!
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: The size is great as is the quality of the Spirit E-210.  I have been very pleased so far.  Just bought this last month and have used it twice so far.  Hoping to have many good times and a long relationship with Weber.
Results.Title: Love the size, love the quality

Results.ReviewText: So far I have been very pleased. Have not done a variety of foods yet, will do a follow up after I have some time with it. Fit and finish are commendable.
Results.Title: New User

Results.ReviewText: It heats up quickly so learn to manage temps. Its well designed for long term use. Parts that normally go bad can be replaced easily. The pit is designed to cut down on grease fires for safety. All trays are removable. Nice!  No complaints at all!
Results.Title: The Best grill ever owned!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had this grill for about a month so far and it works great!  Instructions on assembling were very clear and accurate. Extremely pleased with my new grill!
Results.Title: Extremely Pleased!

Results.ReviewText: We shopped around for the features we wanted but in a small size grill and found all we wanted in this grill. Our local hardware store assembled and delivered it and even hauled our old one away. We look forward to YEARS of happy grilling on our new Weber gas grill!
Results.Title: Absolutely LOVE this new Weber Spirit grill!!!

Results.ReviewText:
Positives- small footprint and fold down side tables make this the perfect grill for my small balcony.  The cooking area is surprisingly large and I don't find that I have challenges with taking care of large quantities of food.

Negatives- in cool or cold weather I have challenges getting it up to temperature.  Also, tube in the rear of the unit that delivers gas from the left burner to the right burner creates a hot spot in the rear of the grilling surface.

Overall it's a great grill and I would highly recommend to anyone with limited space but unlimited grilling needs.
Results.Title: Small footprint but surprisingly large capacity

Results.ReviewText: Great grill.  Cooks meat just right as long as you read and follow the instructions in the book.  Meat doesn’t stick to grill, a great plus and makes clean up so much better.  The only downside is the knobs slide off to easily.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: So far, so good. Perfect for me and my wife. No operating or quality issues.
Results.Title: Our new grill

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking your time to submit your review! We will be sure to pass your feedback to our part team. In fact most of our product changes and updates are direct result of customer feedback!
ClientResponses.Name: WeberGrills

Results.ReviewText: Would rather have stainless steel grill plates but they are not available for the E-210 model.
Results.Title: E-210 gas grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill has served my family well.  It was knocked over twice from storms (my negligence).  I had to replace a burner tube because of the storm damage but since it's  so well made that's the only issue I've had.  Highly recommend!
Results.Title: Excellent grill

Results.ReviewText: It is over a month since purchased. Missing two parts and cannot get a response via email, twitter or phone. Their customer service recording tells you to visit the website then disconnects. Yet, everyday I get emails from Weber promoting new products. Do yourself a favor and get a grill from someone with a reputable Customer service department.
Results.Title: Terrible Customer 'Service'

Results.ReviewText: My old grill had seen it's better days. I set out to look for a replacement and wanted one made in the USA. I went to my local Lowe's store where I found the perfect grill for me. I have used it about 6 times so far. It was easy to assemble and works just like it should!
Results.Title: Made in the USA

Results.ReviewText: After years of buying less expensive grills I finally bought a Weber grill. Just opening the lid let's you know it is quality. I do believe this grill will last longer than 3-5 years like others I have bought. I also like the even heating of the frill surface. A real even heat without hot spots. Items that look like they may need to be replaced are easy to get to. The E-210 is large enough for the average family.
Results.Title: Weber Lover.

Results.ReviewText: The cooking grates are divided up into thirds and makes it hard to slide across the length of grate without hitting a raised part of the grate.  We have constant flares ups. It hard to move across uneven surfaces. Hey the electric starter has worked three times, more than the last electric start we had.
Results.Title: Only if i had known

Results.ReviewText: This is a very well-designed and well-made small grill. It’s perfect for my husband and me. We bought it about a month ago and have made pizza, chicken, and peppers. I especially like that the side tables fold down, Making even a smaller footprint.
Results.Title: Perfect for a couple.

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill! Gets real hot and cooks them ribeyes
Results.Title: This grill is great

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased the Spirit E-210 Gas grill a little over a month ago and we've grilled 6 or 7 times so far.  This is the smallest grill that we've owned and fits a retiree's lifestyle perfectly.  Can easily cook for 6-8 of us (as long as we socially distance).  It's easy to clean, has an even heating and is a pleasure to use.

The only issue that we have is with the grilling grates - my salesperson at the local hardware store said the grates could be used on either side - a more flat surface grate or the side that gives more distinct grill marks (which we like).  When using the side to produce better grill marks, the surface has divider ridges that separate the grill into 6 sections.  Spatulas do not slide across these dividers and makes it a bit more difficult to work with.

All-in-all its a very good grill as we expected when purchasing a Weber.  Happy grilling!
Results.Title: The little grill that could

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill. Have used it for chicken, steak, hamburgers and kabobs. They came out perfect each time. Best grill I’ve ever owned.
Results.Title: Best grill I’ve ever owned

Results.ReviewText: j’ai acheter ce bbq un mois passer et c’est vraiment le meilleur achat à date j’adore mon BBQ je le recommande fortement
Results.Title: Meilleur achat à date j’adore

Results.ReviewText: I’m not going to write a book. This grill is awesome. It’s not huge but but that’s why I bought it. Even heat all over. I would definitely buy again.
Results.Title: Wonderful little grill

Results.ReviewText:
This grill is ideally suited to our needs, small, easy to positiion, easy to clean & is very fast in cooking foodstuffs. 

However there are two items which I would like to mention:

1. The position of the "fuel gauge" inside the cabinet is impossible to use. The propane tank cannot be conveniently positioned & lifted on to the "cradle" as it is too heavy for me( I am 87 years of age). I would suggest locating the fuel gauge on the exterior of the grill, perhaps to the rear of the grill.

2. Further to the to placement of the grill inside the cabinet, is it possible to design the floor so that the propane tank rests on the floor? In order to conveniently move the grill whilst in operation I have had to   add slats to rest the tank on so that the casters can move the entire unit.
Results.Title: Helpful Hints

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Better results compared to my last one. It's also easier to clean. I'm hoping this one won't rust too soon. I saw several complaints about the bottom rusting out within 3 years which was disconcerting.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is a very nice grill.  Love how quickly it heats up and I really like that the propane tank is held in a way that shows how full the tank is.  Highly recommend this grill especially if you use a grill a lot like we do.  We have had less expensive grills previously but they never last. This one is worth the extra cost.
Results.Title: Totally worth it

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit E-210 is a great grill.  I love the way it cooks.
Results.Title: Love my grill

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill.. Does more than I ever expected.. Cooks very efficiently and was a rewarding purchase.
Results.Title: Weber..A Very Powerful  Cooking System.

Results.ReviewText: Great for a small space.  Powerful and well built.
Results.Title: Well built

Results.ReviewText:
We have a full size Genesis grill at home that we had for years. It is the best grill I have ever had.
We bought a smaller Weber grill here in Florida. It was an easy decision to make because of the performance and reliability we have gotten earlier.
I have used the E-210 numerous times and am very happy again. Weber, in my opinion, makes great grills,
Results.Title: Weber E-210 grill

Results.ReviewText:
This our my First Weber Grill and we our enjoying it immensely.
Since my wife likes her beef well and I like mine medium, I had
to figure out how to control the temperature. On the E210 Weber,
there are only 2 burners (I am use to cooking on 3 or more), so if
we only have a small amount to cook, I only turn the left burner on.
If I need to boost the temperature, I fire up the second burner for a
short time. Of course if you are cooking for a group or are cooking
larger portions, fire up both burners from the start. I found out the
E210 gets hot pretty quick and makes it a little more difficult to 
cook to your preference. I hope this helps. Happy Grilling!
Results.Title: Controlling Temps

Results.ReviewText: It heats up quickly, cools down quickly. Cooks very well.
Results.Title: Love the E-210 Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have owned this grill for over 5 years and I am just now about to buy some new parts for it. It cooks extremely even and will most definitely be purchasing again!
Results.Title: Best Value!!!

Results.ReviewText: This is the best BBQ I've had for under $1000! Very well built with easy to access cleaning trays. I now look for any reason to use my BBQ!
Results.Title: Best Ever!

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
